text: I feel that I need to end my present relationship. He lives three hours away and likes the reassurance of having someone to talk to multiple times per day and seeing me once or twice a month. I want someone who is more present and more of a life companion. Lately, he has had a very busy work schedule and I have only seen him a few times in the last 6 weeks. I told him that I can't continue in this way because I constantly feel frustrated and angry and that he is not making the relationship enough of a priority. I also feel it is keeping me from possibly finding the relationship I want. We have been together 7 years. The problem is that I panic and experience anxiety and depression thinking of him with someone else and then thinking I will never meet someone I like. We have gone through this cycle already 4-5 times and I feel it is unhealthy to stay in it, but my aversion to the anxiety and depression I experience upon separation always leads me to reconcile.

I've had posttraumatic stress disorder for years without my parents ever finding out. I want to overcome it, but it’s so vivid, it’s like it’s happening again. I'm scared and paranoid. I have depression, which I have been struggling with since a young age.

I had a head injury a few years ago and my mind races all the time. I have trouble sleeping and have a lot of anxiety. Every medicine I have been on my body rejects; I get sick to my stomach and get blisters in my mouth. How can I calm my self down? I'm a wreck.
He is verbally abusive. When he gets mad, he just yells at me. At times, I feel scared.

My boyfriend and I have been going out for about a year. I suddenly find myself jealous when I see him talking to other girls. I have never been this way before. I don't like these feelings. He said that my jealousy would cause our relationship to have problems. I told him I can't help these feelings. I don't know where they are coming from, but this is how I feel, I tried to stop, but I can't. I really like this guy, but I'm afraid that I'm messing up the relationship. It's just stupid.

Sometimes, I'm fine and can go out or meet people, but other days, my heart races and words physically cannot come out of my mouth. I've always thought it was normal and I was just nervous, but the other day, it took me almost 30 minutes of sitting in my car to find the courage to enter Target by myself.

I have dog obsession disorder and I am having problems with my girlfriend because I am placing more importance to my two dogs over her. How do I get over this problem and prioritize my girlfriend over my two dogs?

I'm always told I'm not good enough or trying hard enough. I put 100% in to every thing. I'm worn out, I've worked on all of my family relationships, I'm doing great in school, I'm kind to those in need and otherwise. I stick to my religious beliefs and leave room for mistakes and learn from others so I don't have to make as many and the ones I do I learn from. Somehow it's still not good enough and nothing I do works. Nothing has changed, and I feel hopeless. Any suggestions or ideas?

Two years ago, I was separated from the military into my contract for medical issues. It has emotionally destroyed me. I now basically hate myself. It's embarrassing to be separated from the one place who takes anyone. My family has been in the armed forces, and it has always been my dream. I can't do this alone anymore, and now my family is even worried.

I have no idea what happened. I go places and do things but still feel lonely. I honestly have no friends, and I am always the one texting people and bothering people. I feel invisible, like someone that no one wants to be around.

My boyfriend and I have a toxic relationship due to his emotional and verbal abuse but he makes me feel like I could never find someone better, and that I can't be happy without him. How do I get away from this relationship?

We got into arguments, and we would break if off but start it back up again. We clicked, or so I thought. We are both married with problems in our marriage. We never have sex; we just send a lot of pictures back and forth and talk about doing things together. His wife found out, and he lied to her and didn't even refer to it as an affair. I can't stop thinking about him. We just click. I've been married for 16 years, and I've never liked anyone other than my husband. Now I like him, and we’ll never be together.

My mother has Alzheimer's and she has become so nasty and mean to everyone and she always asks for unrealistic, silly or meaningless items. I get so frustrated and angry, but then I feel guilty because I know it probably isn’t her fault. How can I cope with feeling like this?

I am going through a divorce. He is extremely angry. He refuses to physically assist me with our teenager daughter. I have no extended family support. Often times, I feel overwhelmed, tired, and joyless. I feel out of control, sad and depressed on a daily basis. I am just going through the motions of life every day. I am in my mid-50s. I have almost 29 years on my job. How can I handle this?
I have known I was always different. This year, in December, I found out that I never felt female. I did research and have identified myself as male but don't know how to tell my dad.
I've have lived for sometime with depression but things have gotten a lot better, but why is it so hard to get over anxiety and social isolation?

I think adult life is making him depressed and we often sleep in on weekends untill 1 or 2 pm. We just eat, smoke weed, watch movies, and he'll go on his phone all day. He doesn't seem motivated to do much and he's often angry. I have no clue how to help him take his mind off the negative, or to distract him into a different light. How do I help him?

I'm a teenager, and I just got my first job. I am a month and a half in. Yesterday, my boss pushed me to the point where I had to go to the restroom and cry. She didn't see me, and I'm glad, but when I went to talk to her about it today, I let a tear or two come out. I hate it. I feel like they're not going to keep me anymore.

An organization admitted to implanting thoughts in my head with technologies. The study was to implant a fantasy other people are having, but to me, it's a nightmare. I lost my kids, my job, and all that. I was an unwilling participant. I no longer trust a therapist. I'm too afraid to go under hypnosis or anything.

I'm a male in my early 20s. Lately, my paranoia about being around kids is causing me too breathe heavy and sweat a lot. I then start to act weird because I'm trying to fight my paranoia. This leads to people starring at me because they don't know that I'm suffering from panic attacks and paranoia. They just notice me acting scared around kids and they think I'm a threat because of it. I'm not a pervert or predator. I would never hurt a kid. I like kids and don't know why I'm so scared to be around them. I don't understand why I feel like this. Am I a bad person? How do I make this stop?

My partner and I have had an amazing relationship and connection for over two years. We're very committed to each other and are planning a very long life together. However, he recently was very open and honest that he isn't interested in having sex with me anymore. He says this has happened in every past relationships and has ended it as a result. He knows it's because it's the "same person" feeling, but how can he get over this?

My boyfriend won't touch me intimately, he won't kiss me while we are having sex and he won't have oral sex with me. I know he has done this things with other women in the past. I don't know why he won't do them with me. What should I do?

My wife is trying to leave. She agreed to come back and give me a little time. Even said she hopes I can do it. We buried our first born in Jan 13 years ago. She never got past it. So every year around this time, she gets emotional and says she doesn't think she loves me, but then we go back to normal. This time, another guy came in and showed her attention. I'll forgive the cheating if she'll come home.

There is just no communication at all between us. She sleeps constantly all day (not at night). She acts angry and unfocused and stays in her very messy room all the time. The only time she comes out is to eat. She has aches and fatigue, weight gain, hair loss and skin problems. She does not look after her health. I don't know how to communicate with her. She is not open to any suggestions. How do I get through to her?

I don’t love my sister. I would never wish her harm, but if I could, I would wish for us not to be related. Is this cruel? Why must blood mean we have to be friends? Am I being unreasonable and is there a way to fix this? I do care about her, like I do every human being, but I’d rather be with my friends than be with her at all. It’s not just a "teenager phase." I still love my mom and dad, and I’m very close to them. However, it’s my sister I don’t love or have ever really liked at all.
I have family issues, and my dad was both violent and a cheater.

I am broke, but I am sure I have been depressed for the past couple of years. I have always had anxiety. I just need someone to talk to right now. I don't have any friends or family I can talk to. I'm on the verge of just giving up.

I have so many issues to address. I have a history of sexual abuse, I’m a breast cancer survivor and I am a lifetime insomniac. I have a long history of depression and I’m beginning to have anxiety. I have low self esteem but I’ve been happily married for almost 35 years. I’ve never had counseling about any of this. Do I have too many issues to address in counseling?

I got engaged, and everything was going well. Things went downhill at some point, and I broke off the engagement due to an opportunity to go to college. After that, I found out she had been cheating on me. I think about her all the time now, and we have been communicating on and off, but my friends/family don't know.
In particular during family gatherings (such as funerals), where there are different customs.

My wife works late most days, so I'm lonely. I love my wife with all my heart, however I don't feel the intimacy we used to have. We don't have sex anymore, which bothers me tremendously. I have become close friends with a coworker, which I know is not helping. Nothing will happen with that, but there’s the thought.

That phrase makes me crazy. It happens anytime I point out something to my husband that he needs to change, such as looking up from his iPad long enough for me to tell him the grandbaby almost pulled the shelf unit over or explaining to him that I got all the things he needs to bake a pie. Another example is when he opens the front door, the dog runs out if he doesn't pick him up. Over and over again, he lets the dog run out, and I am afraid he will get hit by a car.

At a friend's house, we had some drinks and watched some television. He got up and went to bed. I felt sick. He came out to see if I was okay, and I said no. I said I wanted to go home, and he told me to come lay down. As I laid down on the bed, he started touching me. A friend called me, then I able to leave.

I am a teenager. I have been experiencing major episodes of depression (if that's even what it is) for several years. It’s always getting worse. I have been having panic attacks, feeling like I can't control my fears, and I can't even bring myself to care if I live or die anymore. The problem is that I don't know who to ask for help. When I try to talk to my parents, I freeze completely and can't do anything but make a joke because never once in my life have we talked about our feelings.

I had to go to the emergency room today to get an X-ray of my spine. My boyfriend didn't want to sit there and wait with me. Instead, he wanted to go do things for his friends while I waited. When I was done, he was twenty minutes late in picking me up. He doesn't understand why I'm mad, and we keep bickering at each other over the smallest things. He thinks I don't have a reason to be mad, but I believe that I do.

My girlfriend recently started hanging out a lot more with one of her friends who did her wrong in the past and just walked out on her. So for the past 3 years its been just me and my girlfriend. Things have been great up until the last month. Now she ignores me and texts and hangs oit with her friend more and more. I dont know what to do anymore. My girlfriend is so distant. How do I keep from losing her?
There's this boy who asked me out awhile ago. I said no because my friends and family would think weirdly of me. How do I be with him and tell him and tell my friends?

People who are parental figures in my life have, in the past, hurt me, and some continue to do so. It makes me feel like I'm not good enough for my husband or the life he provides me. I have had jobs, but I am going through a lot of my past garbage and trying to figure out when it all went wrong. Any time I bring these things up, I am expected to be over the issue. These are people that you can't just cut out, but I have never received apologies for so much of my pain. I don't know what to do any more. I don't know who I am anymore.
What makes a healthy marriage last?
Example would be homecoming? I was at my high school's home football game on Friday, and I left because I felt uncomfortable with all the people there and I just wanted to be by myself. Why is that?
I feel like I have to be promiscuous in order to keep people around? It started after I got raped by my ex-boyfriend.
I found out today that my wife is cheating on me. I love her, but she won’t tell the truth even when I have proof. When I beg her to tell the truth, she yells, cusses, and gets a huge attitude.
I'm constantly in a bad mood and I have no energy. Is that depression?

As I was growing up, my mother and father always fought. With that, I grew trust issues. I think it's going to affect my relationship now and end it sooner then I want to. I try not to let it affect me, but I can’t.

In middle school and high school, my friends and family thought I was gay. I tried telling them, but they wouldn’t believe me. It almost feels like they wanted me to be. Now I’m actually starting to believe them. I know I wasn’t back then, and now I’m not sure anymore.

I feel like I am not at a good state of mind. I'm very unsettled in my soul. I'm not happy with myself or the decisions I make, which makes me not happy with anyone else. I feel like a failure most of my days. I don't feel like I'm good at anything anymore. I feel like less of a person.

I have been falling into a deep depression where I can no function during the day and night. The only time I am at peace is when I’m asleep. If I am with friends, family, at work, and mainly alone, I cannot think straight. I no longer feel like myself.

We had our first kid 15 years ago, and sex has been nonexistent ever since. It only happens every three or four months. We have been to counseling, and I have been told over and over again she will come around. She hasn't, and I'm intimately lonely! I think it's time to move on, but how do I do that without hurting my kids?

I'm in my late teens and live with my dad. The only time I go out is for my college classes. Sometimes when I see my friends I want to talk with them, but sometimes I won't want to talk to them for days or even weeks. Sometimes I feel i'm not worth knowing or i'm never going to do anything right. Are they right, am I depressed?
I feel like I hate myself physically and emotionally sometimes. How can I start accepting myself and be more confident?

I know someone who is extremely sensitive to stress and very sensitive to a negative tone of voice. Sometimes during a disagreement he tells me that my communication is having a harmful impact on him. Once he believes I am being negative I can't seem to find a better way of communicating. In fact, it is often a self fulling prophesy because his accusatory manner becomes unbearably frustrating. What advice might you offer?

I'm socially awkward. I've always want to be popular. I've had the opportunity to be popular, but every time I get i,t I'm too scared. All I have to do is talk the popular people. They're really nice to me, but I'm too scared of change. I really want to work up the courage to lose my fear.

I feel insecure in my life. I don't think my wife truly wants our relationship even though she says she does. I have turned to drinking to help relieve my repressed stress about this and other issues. I have had a drinking problem for a few years. I feel the reason I drink is not just because I like to, but because I have lately been on edge. I’ve been very oddly emotional when watching movies that I have been watching for years. I’m paranoid about driving on main roads. I’m very jumpy at the slightest noises.
I did some horrible sexual things as a kid and I regret everything. Can someone help me cope with myself? Can someone help me remember my past?

My wife and mother are having tense disagreements. In the past, they’ve had minor differences. For example, my wife would complain to me my mother is too overbearing; my mother would complain my wife is lazy. However, it’s intensified lately. I think the cause is my wife talked back to her once. Now, any little disagreement is magnified, leading to major disagreements. What can I do?
I was raped by multiple men, and now I can't stand the sight of myself. I wear lingerie to get my self excited enough to have sex with my wife.

When my daughter is stressed about a silly thing from school, she starts crying and freaking out. She is a bright student, always has a 4.0, but I am afraid she is stressing too much. I’m afraid it’s going to break her. I don't know if I should get her to a doctor or someone because this is not normal.
I always feel like I'm doing something wrong. Everything I do is crappy. I want to cry all the time. I can't eat or sleep.

My husband and I are in a terrible place. Part of me wants to fix it, but then I'm caught up with not knowing how and not being able to communicate my feelings to him because he always feels I'm blaming him. Sometimes I am because the feelings of distrust are so strong. I feel they must be coming from something he's doing, but sometimes I know I'm being irrational. Still, that doesn't stop the anxiety. The other half of the time, I just want to walk away, but I feel like that will only be a temporary fix.

I was raped a couple months ago, Since then, along with other unfortunately events that have occurred, I have been having trouble feeling emotions. It's almost as if I'm a sociopath lacking any feeling. What can I do to change this?

I was with my friends at the park, and we were talking and having fun. After a while, I met a girl there. We talked and flirted for a while, then we gave our numbers to each other and left. We talked for a few months, then we met up again. She kissed me, so I assumed we were dating. Then I found out she has a boyfriend.

Cheating is something unacceptable for me but because we have two daughters I decided not to break up the family. However, now I am struggling to forget and forgive what happened. I feel like I cannot trust him. Without trust, I cannot stay in this relationship. On the other hand, I do not want my children to get hurt. I'm not sure how to move forward?
I have been dealing with depression and anxiety for a number of years. I have been on medication, but lately my depression has felt worse. Can counseling help?

Every once and a while, I think about my ex-boyfriend from four years ago, and my current friend. It’s like I can't get past it, and I need some kind of closure. I keep thinking about how we had something, but it got cut off due to parental intervention. Nothing was ever wrong with it. Now we've become friends, but there's this huge sexual tension between us, or at least I feel it when we're physically in the same place. Two summers ago, we saw each other casually for a while, but we never had sex then or while we were dating, which was only for two months three years ago. I'm now in my 20s, and my current boyfriend is amazing and in his 30s. Despite the age difference, I know we're a really good match. We've never really fought and are able to make compromises and talk everything out. I tell him everything. Also, my ex-boyfriend has a girlfriend now as well. He’s been seeing her on and off for the past two and a half years, besides when they broke up and we had our casual thing. That summer, I told him I didn't want anything serious and broke it off. Only a week later, he had gotten back together with his girlfriend. His girlfriend is kind of mean spirited. I'm sure she may be different around him, but I worry about him committing to her in the long run. They're supposed to move in together soon. But still, I feel this connection with my ex-boyfriend, and I feel like he does too. I don't know what to do. I need some closure or I'm not going to be able to move on from this. I don't know what it is, but it's driving me crazy. I’m so happy with my current boyfriend, and I know he will do everything in his power to make my life beautiful and fulfilling. He’s such a good person. I also know my ex-boyfriend smokes marijuana and does other things, but I can't get it out of my head. I'm trying to take a nap right now between classes, but I can't sleep because my mind is racing. I've never been so hung up on something for this long ever. I want to just talk it out with my ex-boyfriend, but I don't know if that's a good idea because of the possibility that it could blow up in my face. If he told his girlfriend, everything could go wrong because she hates me. If my current boyfriend knew, he would be crushed. On one hand, I want my ex-boyfriend to say no to having feelings for me, but I would be terrified of what to do if he said he has feelings too. Where would I go from there? On the other hand, I feel like I can't move forward in my relationship with my current boyfriend without closure from this. Sometimes I wish I could just cut off everything that had to do with my ex, but I don't want to. Please help me, because I really have no idea what to do.

I'm a teenager. I get random spurts of anger, like complete, pure rage. I figured it was hormones, but others notice it too. I get self-destructive. I used to cut but stopped. Now when I get mad, I bite my arms and fingers, pull my hair, scratch my face, or punch my thighs. Basically, I do things I can hide instead of breaking anything in my room and having to explain it to my mom. I don't live in a bad household. I have a great family, a great relationship with my boyfriend, and a good job. I have no idea what this is and I don't know how to control it. It's over any little thing. Tonight, it was because I couldn't get my earrings out. This happens maybe two to three times on a good week, and it's always over stupid, petty things.

I nanny a three year old. When he wakes up in the morning he calls out for someone to come get him. If I am the one to go get him out of bed he gets really upset and refuses to let me near him. He screams that he wants his mom or dad (they work from home). The rest of the day he loves me. But not in the mornings. What can I do?

I have friends, family, I live in a good home, I go to a nice high school, and I get pretty good grades, but I don’t know why I'm so unhappy. These friends are my best friends and they’re all amazing people, and yet I'm sad all the time and feel alone.

When I go to school, I feel like everyone is judging me, even my friends. I get overwhelmed which these thoughts and sometimes cannot get out of what I call a deep hole of thoughts. I barely go to any of our school dances because of all of the people. Not even when I am completely alone do these thoughts go away. I still feel like people can see me and are judging me.

I've hit my head on walls and floors ever since I was young. I sometimes still do it but I don't exactly know why, I have anxiety and I had a rough childhood but now I'll start to hit my head and sometimes not realize it but I don't know how to stop or even why I'm doing it. How can I help myself to change my behavior?
I have been dating my boyfriend for a month, and we want a baby. We don't work or drive, and we haven't talked to our parents. What should we do?

Ever since I was little, I loved the idea of loving someone and spending my whole life with them. I treated everyone nice. For girls I liked, I would spend every second with them. It always ends the same way: “I like you as a friend,” or “I love your attention but not you.”

I've never been able to talk with my parents. My parents are in their sixties while I am a teenager. I love both of them but not their personalities. I feel that they do not take me seriously whenever I talk about a serious event in my life. If my dad doesn’t believe me, then my mom goes along with my dad and acts like she doesn’t believe me either. I’m a pansexual, but I can’t trust my own parents. I've fought depression and won; however, stress and anxiety are killing me. I feel that my friends don't listen to me. I know they have their own problems, which I do my best to help with. But they don't always try to help me with mine, when I really need them. I feel as if my childhood has been taken from me. I feel as if I have no one whom I can trust.

We rent from from my boyfriend's parents. His father drops by unannounced and stays for long periods of time. He lets himself into our home when we aren't there on a daily basis and takes our dogs to his house. He picks up our mail. He has NO boundaries. He's an opinionated, rude pushy person. He expects to spend every weekend around us, gives unsolicited advice on child rearing and does not respect our privacy at all. He barges in with no warning. He has a key and lets himself into our house without asking permission. I need help. How do I address this?

I started dating a guy I met online. He told me that he registered sex offender but he didn't do anything. He took a plea to always register as sex offender and he did two years. That was more than two decades ago. Nothing on his record since. I always believe the past should be left in past. But my roommates, their family and my son are unforgiving. Should I forgive this man that I'm falling in love with or should I dump him? If I stay with him I will never see my family and granddaughter again.

I was in a relationship with a woman for four years. We both made mistakes, but I do love her. She has moved in with another lady. I think she is just cheating on me to make me miss her. How can I find out for sure?

Whenever I run into a situation that makes me upset or angry, I tend to start cursing and badly offending the person I am confronting. I say mean things to let my anger out. Whenever people tell me stuff about my relationship (like starting rumors or saying negative things about me or my relationship) I lash out not just them but at my boyfriend. I feel like I keep causing drama due to my personality. I want to be a better person and learn to let things not get to me and be happy and graceful. I hurt the ones I love with my words. I want to be better for myself and them.

A lot of times, I avoid situations where I am to meet new people because I have a fear of embarrassing myself. I often avoid large groups of people, like parties, because I think they all constantly judge me.

I started seeing this guy that I met at a mutual friend’s place. He recently broke up with his ex-girlfriend and started seeing me. Everything was great in the beginning, then I started having low self-esteem thoughts and thinking he was hanging with his ex-girlfriend again. It’s all I think about. I am still seeing him, but things have changed because I am at a loss for words. I get stuck in my own thoughts. I like and care for him a lot. He just makes me nervous and gives me the butterflies.
After 40 years of being straight, how could I now find myself interested in people of the same sex? I have had a few same sex encounters of my own doing.

Every time I speak, he says I anger him. Also, when he’s mad at something, like work, he gets angry at me. I feel like we’re so distant from each other now. We used to laugh all the time, and I feel like he lets too much negativity in. What should I do? We've been married for two years but together for seven.
It happens especially at me and my sister, and then she gets emotional and brings up the past. How should I deal with it? She is always stressed about her work and doesn't put her family first.

For some reason I feel very uncomfortable with my girlfriend showing off her body in certain poses on social media. I know she is proud of her body and I respect that, but I dont feel comfortable with her openly showing off her body the way she does. Anytime I bring it up to her she thinks Im calling her a whore. How can I deal with my girlfriend showing off her body on social media and not hurt her feelings?

I have been dating a guy for two years. I think I love him, but I don't know any more. I am in my late teens, and I have been living with him for most of our relationship. I have been talking to a guy friend, and I feel more loved by him than my boyfriend.
I have manic depression and last summer was very very bad. I have recurring nightmares and I avoid anything that will give me a similar feeling as I did that summer.

I’m a senior high school student. I’m also five months pregnant. I got pregnant by my boyfriend of three years. My parents don’t want us to communicate with each other. He can’t even come to visit my gynecologist. My mom goes to attend all of my doctor’s appointments. She’s supportive of me. I wish, though, that my boyfriend was next to me and be able to see his daughter on a sonogram, at the very least. My family does not understand that he deserves that much. I cry all the time because I feel lost and hopeless. I need guidance and I believe that you can give it to me. Am I wrong for wanting him around? Are they right for keeping him away from the appointments and not letting us communicate with each other even though we are the parents? I do everything that they ask of me. I just want him to be around. When I ask my parents to let him be here, they call me a selfish person. Please help me.

My husband used a lot of negative words to hurt me, and I moved out. He is seeing a counselor and wants another chance to make things right. I'm not sure if I trust that he will not go back to his old ways.
I feel really uncomfortable when I have people's attention. It makes me not want to talk in public or answer questions in class. Can I get over this social anxiety?
I've gone to a couple therapy sessions so far and still everytime I walk in I get nervous and shaky. Is this normal? Should I still be feeling like this?
I have three siblings. My mom loves them and not me. She’s always yelling at me, but when it comes to my siblings, she talks to them. I’m always crying in my room.

My husband took a job out of state for the next year and seems to be a different person. Before, he worked and slept, and on off days, he'd stay home because he didn't want to do anything else. Now he's going out with friends several nights a week while I'm still home working a 50 hours a week job and taking care of two kids by myself. He's suddenly saying he misses me and wants me to be his adored wife, but the whole time, I'm remembering how I've been emotionally starving for the last five years.

Numva ngomba kurangiza umubano wanjye.Abana banjye baba kure amasaha atatu kandi bakunda kumva ko hari umuntu baganira inshuro nyinshi ku munsi kandi ko bambona rimwe cyangwa kabiri mu kwezi.Nashaka umuntu uriho kandi ari mugenzi wanjye mu buzima.Muri iyi minsi, afite gahunda y'akazi yihariye kandi mu byumweru 6 bishize namubonye inshuro nkeya gusa.Namubwiye ko ntashobora gukomeza muri ubu buryo kuko mpora numva ncitse intege kandi ndakariye kandi ko adashyira umubano imbere bihagije.

Mfite ikibazo cy'ihungabana ry'ibikomere mu gihe cy'imyaka myinshi ababyeyi banjye bataramenya. Nashakaga kugitsinda ariko ni ibintu bikomeye cyane, ni nk'aho byongeye kuba. Mfite ubwoba kandi ndumva mfite ubwoba. Mfite ikibazo cy'agahinda, kandi kuva nkiri muto ndakibura.

Mfite ikibazo cy'uburwayi mu mutwe, ubu mfite ibibazo byo kuryama, mfite n'imihangayiko myinshi, imiti yose nagiye nkoresha umubiri wanjye irabyanga, ndwara mu nda, nkagira ibisebe mu kanwa, nshobora nte kwihorera?
Iyo arakariye, arankankankankankankira, rimwe na rimwe nkumva mfite ubwoba.

Njye n'umukunzi wanjye tumaze umwaka tubonana. Ndumva mpangayitse iyo mbonye aganira n'abandi bakobwa. Sinigeze ngira bene ako kageni mbere. Sinkunda ibyo byiyumvo. Yavuze ko ishyari ryanjye ryatuma umubano wacu ugira ibibazo. Namubwiye ko ntashobora guhangana n'ibyo byiyumvo. Sinzi aho bituruka, ariko uko ni ko numva, nagerageje kubireka, ariko sinshobora. Nkunda uyu musore cyane, ariko mfite ubwoba ko ndimo guhungabanya umubano. Ni ubupfapfa gusa.
Rimwe na rimwe, ndumva meze neza kandi nshobora gusohoka cyangwa guhura n'abantu, ariko ku yindi minsi, umutima wanjye uratemba kandi amagambo yanjye ntashobora gusohoka mu kanwa.
Mfite ikibazo cyo kurwara imbwa, kandi mfite ibibazo n'umukunzi wanjye kuko nshyiraho imihati myinshi kugira ngo imbwa zanjye zibane na we.

Buri gihe bambwira ko ntari mwiza bihagije cyangwa ko ntari gukora cyane. Mfite ibyo nshaka byose 100%. Ndarambiwe, nakoreye ku miryango yanjye yose, nize neza ku ishuri, ndi mwiza ku bakene n'ibindi. Nkunda imyizerere yanjye, nkabikira abandi amakosa kandi nkabikorana umwete kugira ngo ntakora byinshi kandi ibyo nkora ndabikora.

Imyaka ibiri ishize, natandukanyijwe n'igisirikare kubera ibibazo by'ubuvuzi. Ibyo byanshenye mu byiyumvo. Ubu mu by'ukuri niyanze. Birambabaza kuba natandukanyijwe n'aho umuntu wese ajya. Umuryango wanjye wari mu gisirikare, kandi buri gihe ni inzozi zanjye. Sinashobora gukora ibi jyenyine, kandi ubu umuryango wanjye uritotezwa.
Sinzi uko byagenze. Njya ahantu runaka nkakora ibintu ariko nkumva ndi wenyine. Sinagira incuti, kandi buri gihe ni jye woherereza abantu ubutumwa kandi nkababuza amahwemo.

Jye n'umukunzi wanjye dufite umubano w'ubuhumekero bitewe n'uko yannyuzura mu buryo bw'ibyiyumvo no mu mvugo ariko bituma numva ko ntazigera nsanga umuntu mwiza, kandi ko ntashobora kugira ibyishimo ntamufite.

Twaraganiriye, turaganira, ariko tukongera gutangira. Twarakomeje, cyangwa ni uko nabitekerezaga. Twese turi abaseribateri dufite ibibazo mu mubano wacu. Ntitwigeze dukora imibonano mpuzabitsina; twohereza amafoto menshi tuganira ku byo dukora dufatanyije. Umugore we yarabimenye, aramubeshya kandi ntiyavuga ko ari urukundo. Sinashoboraga kureka kumwibuka. Turakomeje.

Mama arwaye Alzheimer, kandi arasaze kandi arangwa n'ubugome ku bantu bose, kandi buri gihe asaba ibintu bidashyize mu gaciro, bidafite icyo bisobanuye. Ndumva nduhutse kandi ndashavuye cyane, ariko nyuma yaho numva mfite icyaha kuko nzi ko atari ikosa rye.

Ndumva nduhutse, mfite agahinda kandi nihebye, buri munsi mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora mpora
Mu kwezi k'Ukuboza uyu mwaka, namenye ko ntari narigeze numva ndi umugore.
Hari igihe nabaga mfite agahinda kenshi, ariko ibintu byarushijeho kugenda neza. Ariko se kuki bigoye cyane kureka guhangayika no kwiherera mu muryango?

Ndumva ubuzima bw'umuntu mukuru burimo kumutera kwiheba kandi akenshi turyama mu mpera z'icyumweru kugeza saa kumi n'ebyiri z'umugoroba. Turarya gusa, turanywa urumogi, turareba filime, kandi akagenda kuri telefoni ye umunsi wose.

Ndi ingimbi, maze kubona akazi kanjye ka mbere. Mfite ukwezi n'igice. Ejo, umukoresha wanjye yanshyize aho nagombaga kujya mu bwiherero nkarira. Ntiyansabye, kandi ndishimye, ariko ubwo najyaga kumuvugishaho uyu munsi, naretse amarira abiri araturuka.

Umuryango umwe wemeye ko wambujije gutekereza binyuze mu ikoranabuhanga. Icyigisho cyari ugushyiramo ibitekerezo abandi bantu bafite, ariko kuri jye, ni inzozi. Narabuze abana banjye, akazi kanjye, n'ibindi. Nari umuntu utemera. Sincyiringira umuforomo. Ntinya cyane kujya mu buhumekero cyangwa ikindi kintu icyo ari cyo cyose.

Ndi umugabo w'imyaka 20 y'amavuko. Muri iyi minsi, paranoia yanjye yo kuba ndi kumwe n'abana ituma mpumeka cyane kandi nkatinda cyane. Hanyuma ntangira kwitwara nabi kuko ngerageza kurwanya paranoia yanjye. Ibi bituma abantu banyitegereza kuko batazi ko mpanganye n'ibitero by'ubwoba n'ubushotoranyi.

Njye n'uwo twashakanye twamaze imyaka irenga ibiri dufitanye umubano mwiza cyane. Turi abantu bashyize hamwe kandi duteganya kubaho igihe kirekire cyane. Ariko mu minsi ishize, yari yarabaye umunyakuri kandi yarabaye umunyakuri avuga ko atongeye kunyitaho. Avuga ko ibyo byabaye mu mishyikirano yose ya kera kandi ko yabirangije. Azi ko ari uko ari "umuntu umwe" ariko se ibyo ashobora kubirengaho ate?
Umukunzi wanjye ntazankoraho, ntazansoma mu gihe turimo kuryamana, ntazansambanya mu kanwa.

Umugore wanjye arashaka kugenda. yemeye kugaruka akampa akanya gato. ndetse avuga ko yizeye ko nshobora kubikora. Twahambye umwana wacu w'imfura muri Jan 13 ishize. ntiyigeze abirengagiza. bityo buri mwaka muri iki gihe, arushaho kugira ibyiyumvo akavuga ko atekereza ko ankunda, ariko nyuma yaho dusubira mu buzima busanzwe.

Gusa ntaho tuvugana. Aracyarara umunsi wose (si nijoro). Akora ibintu biraka kandi atita ku byo yifuza, akomeza kuba mu cyumba cye cyuzuye imvururu. Igihe cyose asohoka ari kurya gusa. Arababara kandi arambiwe, arushaho kugira ibiro, asubira mu musatsi kandi agashirana n'uruhu. Ntita ku buzima bwe. Sinzi uko namuganiriza. Nta n'icyo amfasha.

Njye sinkunda mushiki wanjye. sinigeze ndamubabaza, ariko iyo mbishobora, nifuza ko tutari incuti. Ese ibi birakomeye? kuki amaraso agomba gutuma tuba inshuti? ese ndi umuntu utumva kandi hari uburyo bwo kubikemura?
Mfite ibibazo mu muryango, kandi papa yari umunyarugomo kandi yari umuhemu.

Nubwo nta cyo mfite, nizera ko mu myaka mike ishize nagiye ndwara indwara yo kwiheba, buri gihe nari mfite imihangayiko, ubu gusa nkeneye umuntu wo kuganira na we, nta n'incuti cyangwa umuryango mfite, ubu ngiye guheba.

Mfite ibibazo byinshi ngomba guhangana nabyo. Mfite amateka y'ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, ndi umurwayi wa kanseri y'ibere kandi ndi umuntu utagira ibitotsi ubuzima bwanjye bwose. Mfite amateka maremare y'ihungabana kandi ntangiye kugira impungenge. Mfite kwiyubaha hasi ariko ndashyingiranywe ibyishimo hafi imyaka 35. Sinigeze ngira inama kuri ibyo byose. Ese mfite ibibazo byinshi byo guhangana nabyo mu gutanga inama?

Naje gushyingiranwa, ibintu byose biragenda neza. Ibintu byagiye bihinduka nabi, maze ndangiza uwo muhango kubera amahirwe yo kujya muri kaminuza. Nyuma yaho, namenye ko yari anshutse. Ndamutekereza igihe cyose ubu, kandi twarimo twumvikana, ariko incuti zanjye / umuryango wanjye ntibizi.
By'umwihariko, iyo abagize umuryango bateranye (urugero nk'ihamba), usanga hari imigenzo itandukanye.

Umugore wanjye akora amasaha y'ikirenga ku munsi, bityo numva ndi wenyine. Nkunda umugore wanjye n'umutima wanjye wose, ariko sinumva ubucuti twari dufite mbere. Ntitugikora imibonano mpuzabitsina, ibyo bintera impungenge cyane. Nagize inshuti magara n'umukozi dukorana, ibyo nzi ko bidufasha. Nta kintu kizagendaho, ariko hari igitekerezo.

Iyo mvugo irantuma mpenda. Iyo mbwiye umugabo wanjye ikintu akeneye guhindura, nk'igihe cyose ndeba iPad ye ndamubaza ko umwuzukuru wanjye yari hafi gusohora ikaramu cyangwa nkamusobanurira ko mfite ibintu byose akeneye kugira ngo atege gato.

Twaraye mu rugo rw'inshuti yacu turanywa, turareba televiziyo. Yahagurutse ajya kuryama. Numvise ndwaye. Yaje kureba niba ntameze neza, maze ndavuga nti oya. Naramubwiye ko nifuzaga gusubira mu rugo, arambwira ngo ndyamye. Igihe naryamye ku buriri, yatangiye kunkorera.

Ndi ingimbi. Mfite imyaka myinshi mpanganye n'ibihe bikomeye byo kwiheba (niba ari byo rwose) buri gihe birushaho kuzamba. Mfite ibitero by'ubwoba, numva ntashobora gutegeka ubwoba bwanjye, kandi sinashobora no kwitekerezaho niba nzongera kubaho cyangwa gupfa. Ikibazo ni uko ntazi uwo nagombye gusaba ubufasha. Iyo ngerageje kuvugana n'ababyeyi banjye, ndakonja rwose kandi nta kindi nshobora gukora uretse gusetsa kuko nta na rimwe mu buzima bwanjye twaganiriye ku byiyumvo byacu.

Uyu munsi nagombaga kujya mu cyumba cy'ubutabazi kugira ngo nkore radiyo y'umugongo wanjye. Umukunzi wanjye ntiyifuzaga kwicara aho ngahangana nanjye. Ahubwo yifuzaga kujya gukorera ibintu incuti ze mu gihe nari ntinze. Igihe narangizaga, yaratinze kumfata iminota makumyabiri. Ntiyumva impamvu ndashavuye, kandi dukomeza guhana ku bintu byoroheje. Atekereza ko nta mpamvu mfite yo kurakara, ariko ndemera ko ndaza.

Umukunzi wanjye aherutse gutangira gusabana cyane n'umwe mu nshuti ze yamukoreye nabi kera maze akamusiga gusa. mu myaka 3 ishize ni njye n'umukunzi wanjye gusa. Ibintu byagenze neza kugeza mu kwezi gushize. ubu aranyihakana kandi arandikirana ubutumwa kandi arushaho gusabana n'umukunzi we. sinzi icyo nkora. umukunzi wanjye ari kure cyane. mbasha kumwirinda nte?
Hari umuhungu wansabye gusohokana na we kera, maze ndamusubiza nti "oya" kuko incuti zanjye n'abagize umuryango wanjye bari kunyitotomba.

Abantu babaye ababyeyi mu buzima bwanjye, mu gihe cyahise, barandenganyije, kandi bamwe bakomeje kubikora. Binyereka ko ntari mwiza bihagije ku mugabo wanjye cyangwa ku buzima ampa. Nari mfite akazi, ariko nkora ibintu byinshi by'ubupfapfa mu gihe cyahise, ngerageza kumenya igihe byose byahise bihinduka nabi. Igihe cyose mbwira ibyo bintu, birashoboka ko nzarangiza icyo kibazo. Abo ni abantu udashobora guca mu nzira gusa, ariko sinigeze menya gusaba imbabazi ku mibabaro yanjye myinshi. Sinzi icyo nakora.
Ni iki gituma ishyingiranwa rirangwa n'amahoro riramba?
Urugero, nari mu mikino yo mu rugo y'ishuri ry'ikirenga ku wa Gatanu, maze ndagenda kuko numvaga ntishimye ndi kumwe n'abantu bose bari aho, kandi nifuzaga kuba jyenyine.
Iyo mbonye ko ngomba kuba umuntu w'igitsina gore kugira ngo abantu bakomeze kumbera hafi, byatangiriye igihe umusore wahoze ari umukunzi wanjye yankubitaga ku ngufu.

Uyu munsi namenye ko umugore wanjye anshuka. Ndamukunda, ariko ntashaka kumvugisha ukuri nubwo naba mfite ibimenyetso. Iyo ndamwingingiye ngo ambwire ukuri, araturika, aranseka, kandi agira imyifatire ikomeye.
Buri gihe mba mfite imimerere mibi kandi nta mbaraga mfite.

Igihe nakuriraga, mama na papa bahoraga bajya impaka. Ibyo byatumye ntangira kugirana ibibazo byo kwizera. Ntekereza ko bizagira ingaruka ku mishyikirano yanjye ubu kandi bikarangira vuba kurusha uko nifuza.

Mu mashuri yisumbuye n'ayisumbuye, inshuti n'abagize umuryango wanjye batekerezaga ko ndi igitsina gore. Nagerageje kubabwira ariko ntibanyemera. Ndumva nkaba barashakaga ko mba. Ubu ntangiye kubabwira ko ntari nkiri igitsina gore, kandi ubu sincyari nzi neza.

Numva ntari mu bwenge bwiza. Ndumva umutima wanjye utekanye cyane. Sinanyurwa n'ibyo niyizi cyangwa imyanzuro mfata, ibyo bituma ntanyurwa n'undi muntu uwo ari we wese. Numva nk'umunyabyaha mu minsi yanjye myinshi.
Iyo ndi kumwe n'incuti, umuryango, ku kazi, kandi cyane cyane ndi jyenyine, ntashobora gutekereza neza. Sincyumva ko ndi umuntu.

Twabyaye umwana wacu wa mbere mu myaka 15 ishize, kandi kuva icyo gihe, imibonano mpuzabitsina ntiyaba ihari. Ibi biba buri mezi atatu cyangwa ane gusa. Twagiye mu buvugizi, kandi nabwiwe kenshi ko azaza. Ntiyaza, kandi numva ndi wenyine cyane!

Ndi mu kigero cy'imyaka ya nyuma y'amabyiruka, nkabana na papa. Igihe cyonyine njya hanze ni mu masomo yanjye ya kaminuza. Rimwe na rimwe iyo mbonye incuti zanjye nshaka kuvugana na zo, ariko hari igihe ntashaka kuvugana na zo iminsi cyangwa se ibyumweru. Hari igihe numva ko nta cyo nkwiriye kumenya cyangwa ko ntazigera nkora ikintu cyiza.
Hari igihe numva niyibagiwe mu buryo bw'umubiri no mu byiyumvo.

Hari umuntu nzi wumva ko hari icyo atwaye, kandi ko hari igihe iyo hari ibyo atumva, ambwira ko ibyo mvuga bimugiraho ingaruka mbi. Iyo amaze kubona ko ari jye ubikora, mbona nta buryo bwiza bwo kubimubwiraho. Mu by'ukuri, akenshi ni ubuhanuzi buvuga ibintu ku giti cye, kubera ko uburyo bwe bwo kumurega butuma umuntu yumva ko nta cyo amaze.

Ndi umuntu udasanzwe mu muryango. Buri gihe nifuza kuba umuntu ukunzwe. Nagize amahirwe yo kuba umuntu ukunzwe, ariko buri gihe iyo mbyifuzaga, numvaga mfite ubwoba. Icyo nkeneye gukora ni ukuganira n'abantu bakunzwe. Baranyitayeho cyane, ariko mfite ubwoba bwo guhinduka.

Numva ntekanye mu buzima bwanjye. Ntekereza ko umugore wanjye yifuza umubano wacu nubwo avuga ko abishaka. Nagiye kunywa inzoga kugira ngo mpumure stress yanjye ivanze n'ibyo n'ibindi bibazo. Mfite ikibazo cyo kunywa imyaka mike. Numva impamvu nywa inzoga atari uko mbishaka gusa, ahubwo ni uko mu minsi ishize ndi mu rujijo. Mbabazwa cyane no kureba filimi namaze imyaka myinshi ndeba. Mbabazwa no gutwara imodoka ku mihanda minini. Mbabazwa cyane n'urusaku rworoheje.
Hari umuntu ushobora kumfasha kwihanganira ibyanjye, hari umuntu ushobora kumfasha kwibuka ibyanjye byahise?

Umugore wanjye na mama bafite amakimbirane akomeye. mu minsi ishize, bagiye bagira amakimbirane mato. Urugero, umugore wanjye yanyitotombera ko mama ari umunyabyaha cyane; mama yanyitotombera ko umugore wanjye ari umunebwe. Ariko, mu minsi ishize, byarakomeje. Ntekereza ko impamvu ari uko umugore wanjye yigeze kumusubiza. Ubu, amakimbirane mato arushaho kwiyongera, bigatuma havuka amakimbirane akomeye. Nakora iki?
Hari abagabo benshi banteye agahomamunwa, none ubu sincyumva ko ndiho, kandi nkora ibintu by'imbere kugira ngo ndusheho kwishima, maze nshobore kuryamana n'umugore wanjye.
Iyo umukobwa wanjye ahangayikishijwe n'ikintu cy'ubupfu cyo mu ishuri, atangira kurira no gutinya. Ni umunyeshuri mwiza, buri gihe afite amanota 4.0, ariko mfite ubwoba ko ahangayikishijwe cyane.
Buri gihe numva ko hari ikintu kibi ndimo nkora, ibyo nkora byose ni bibi, nifuza kurira igihe cyose, sinashobora kurya cyangwa kuryama.

Njye n'umugabo wanjye turi ahantu hateye ubwoba. Igice cyanjye cyashaka kugikemura, ariko nyuma yaho ndumva ntamenya uko mbikora kandi ntashobora kumubwira uko niyumva kuko ahora yumva ko ari njye umurega. Rimwe na rimwe mbikora kubera ko numva ntamufitiye icyizere cyane.
Nyuma y'amezi make, nafashwe ku ngufu, kuva icyo gihe, kimwe n'ibindi bintu bibabaje byabaye, nagiye ngira ibibazo byo kumva ibyiyumvo.

Nari ndi kumwe n'inshuti zanjye muri pariki, turaganira kandi turishimye. Nyuma y'igihe runaka, nahuye n'umukobwa aho ngaho. Twaraganiriye turabeshyaga igihe runaka, hanyuma duhahana nimero zacu turagenda. Twaraganiriye amezi make, hanyuma dusubira guhura. Yarankomeje, ntekereza ko turimo dukundana. Hanyuma nsanga afite umukunzi.

Kuba ndamucumuyeho, ni ikintu ntashobora kwemera, ariko kubera ko dufite abakobwa babiri, niyemeje kudatandukanya umuryango. Ariko ubu ndwana n'uko nibagirwa ibyo byambayeho, nkaba numva ntashobora kumwizera.
Mfite imyaka myinshi mpanganye n'ikibazo cyo kwiheba no guhangayika, kandi nagiye mfata imiti, ariko mu gihe gishize nagiye ndushaho kwiheba.

Rimwe na rimwe, ntekereza ku wahoze ari umukunzi wanjye mu myaka ine ishize, n'uwo mfite ubu. Ni nk'aho ntashobora kurirengagiza, kandi nkeneye uburyo runaka bwo gufunga. Nkunda gutekereza ukuntu twagize ikintu, ariko kikarenganurwa kubera ko ababyeyi bacu batangiye gukora. Nta kibi na kimwe cyabayeho. Ubu twabaye inshuti, ariko hari umunaniro munini w'ibitsina hagati yacu, cyangwa nibura ndawumva iyo turi ahantu hamwe mu buryo bw'umubiri.

Ndi ingimbi. Mfite uburakari buturutse ku munezero, nk'uburakari butagira rutangira. Numvaga ari hormone, ariko n'abandi barabyibuka. Nkunda kwiyahura ariko ndahagarika. Ubu iyo ndwaye, nduma amaboko n'intoki, ndasokoza umusatsi, ndasokoza mu maso, cyangwa nkakubita ibiganza.

Ndi umubyeyi w'umwana w'imyaka itatu. Iyo abyutse mu gitondo ahamagara umuntu ngo aze amufate. Niba ari jye wamuzamura mu buriri ararakara cyane kandi yanga ko mva hafi ye. Arataka ko ashaka ko nyina cyangwa se bamukorera (bakorera iwabo).

Mfite inshuti, umuryango, mba mu rugo rwiza, njya mu ishuri ryisumbuye ryiza, kandi mbona amanota meza, ariko sinzi impamvu ntishimye cyane. Abo nshuti ni incuti zanjye nziza kandi bose ni abantu batangaje, nyamara buri gihe mba mfite agahinda kandi numva ndi jyenyine.

Iyo njya ku ishuri numva ko buri wese ansuzuma, ndetse n'inshuti zanjye. Ndumva ndemerewe cyane n'ibyo bitekerezo kandi rimwe na rimwe ntashobora gusohoka mu byo nitwa icyuho cy'ibitekerezo. Ndetse njya ku ncuro ya mbere mu kubyina kw'ishuri kubera abantu bose. Ndetse n'igihe ndi jyenyine, ibyo bitekerezo ntibivaho. Ndacyumva ko abantu bashobora kunbona bakancira urubanza.

Kuva nkiri muto, nagiye mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita mpita
Mfite ukwezi kumwe n'umukunzi wanjye, twifuza umwana, ntitukora cyangwa ngo dutware imodoka, kandi ntitwaraganiriye n'ababyeyi bacu.

Kuva nkiri muto, nakundaga igitekerezo cyo gukunda umuntu no kumarana n'ubuzima bwanjye bwose. Buri wese nagiriraga neza. Ku bakobwa nakundaga, nakundaga kumarana nabo buri cyinsi. Buri gihe birangira kimwe: Ndagukunda nk'inshuti, cyangwa Nkunda kwitabwaho kwawe ariko si wowe.

Sinigeze nshobora kuganira n'ababyeyi banjye. Ababyeyi banjye bari mu myaka mirongo itandatu y'amavuko nkiri umwangavu. Ndabakunda bombi ariko sinkunda kamere yabo. Numva ko batanyumva mu buryo bwuzuye igihe cyose mvuga ku kintu gikomeye mu buzima bwanjye. Niba papa atanyemera, mama ajya hamwe na papa akigira nk'aho na we atanyemera. Ndi umunyabitsina gabo, ariko sinshobora kwiringira ababyeyi banjye. Narwanye n'agahinda, ariko stress n'imihangayiko biranshyira mu kaga.

Twakodesha ababyeyi b'umukunzi wanjye. Se araza atadutangarije, aguma mu rugo igihe kirekire. Akinjira iwacu tutari kumwe buri munsi, akajyana imbwa zacu iwe. Akuraho amabaruwa yacu. Nta mipaka afite. Ni umuntu w'impuhwe, w'umunyamahane, w'umunyamahane. Atekereza ko buri mpera z'icyumweru azaturera iruhande, atanga inama zidakenewe ku birebana no kurera abana kandi ntiyubahiriza ubuzima bwacu bwite na gato. Yinjira nta muburo. Afite urufunguzo kandi yinjira mu nzu yacu atamubajije.

Nagiye gusohokana n'umusore nahuye na we kuri interineti. yambwiye ko yandikishije ko ari umukozi w'ibitsina ariko nta cyo yakoze. Yasabye ko buri gihe yandikisha ko ari umukozi w'ibitsina kandi yarabikoze imyaka ibiri ishize. Ibyo byabayeho imyaka isaga mirongo ibiri ishize. Kuva icyo gihe nta kintu na kimwe kiri muri dosiye ye. Buri gihe nemera ko ibya kera byagombye kurengaho. Ariko abo tubana, umuryango wabo n'umwana wanjye ntibababarire. Ese nagombye kubabarira uyu mugabo nkunda cyangwa nkamwirukana?
Nari mfite umugore mu mubano w'imyaka ine. Twembi twakoze amakosa, ariko ndamukunda. Yimukiye mu wundi mugore.

Iyo mpanganye n'imimerere ituma ndakara cyangwa ndakara, ntangira kuvuma umuntu mpanganye na we cyangwa kumugirira nabi cyane. Mvuga ibintu bibi kugira ngo ndeke uburakari bwanjye buveho. Igihe cyose abantu bambwiye ibintu ku birebana n'imishyikirano yanjye (nk'uko gutangiza ibihuha cyangwa kuvuga ibintu bibi ku byerekeye jye cyangwa umubano wanjye), sinjye mbarangamira gusa abo bantu ahubwo n'umukunzi wanjye. Numva nkomeza gutera akabariro kubera kamere yanjye. Nkunda kuba umuntu mwiza kandi nkamenya kureka ibintu bikanshishikaza no kugira ibyishimo n'ubwitonzi.
Akenshi nirinda guhura n'abantu bashya kubera ko ntinya kwibabaza, kandi akenshi nirinda abantu benshi, urugero nk'amatsinda, kuko numva ko bose banyicira urubanza.

Natangiye kujya nsanga uyu musore najyaga mpura na we mu nzu y'inshuti. Haje igihe gito atandukanye n'umukunzi we wa kera atangira kumenyana nanjye. Ibintu byose byari byiza mu ntangiriro, nyuma ntangira kugira ibitekerezo byo kwiyemera hasi, ntangira gutekereza ko yongeye gusabana n'umukunzi we wa kera. Ni byo gusa ntekereza. Ndacyamubona ariko ibintu byarahindutse kuko nta magambo mfite. Ndatwarwa n'ibitekerezo byanjye. Ndamukunda kandi ndamuha agaciro cyane. Antera ubwoba gusa akanampa ibishushanyo mbonera.
Nyuma y'imyaka 40 ndi umukinnyi w'umukobwa w'inyuma, ni gute noneho nshobora gushishikazwa n'abantu b'igitsina kimwe?

Buri gihe iyo mvuze, avuga ko ndamurakaza. Nanone iyo arakariye ikintu runaka, urugero nk'akazi, arankarira. Numva tumeze nk'abari kure cyane. Twahoraga duseka, kandi numva ko atuma ibintu bibi birushaho kuba bibi. Nakora iki? Tumaze imyaka ibiri dushyingiranywe ariko tumaze imyaka irindwi turi kumwe.

Iyo ndwaye, numva ko hari ibintu byinshi byambayeho, ariko iyo ndwaye, numva ko hari ibintu byinshi byambayeho, kandi ko hari ibintu byinshi byambayeho, nk'uko nagiye mbikora, nkumva ko hari ibintu byinshi byambayeho.

Hari impamvu ituma numva ntishimye iyo umukunzi wanjye agaragaje umubiri we mu buryo runaka ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Ndabizi ko yishimiye umubiri we kandi ndawubaha, ariko sinumva meze neza iyo agaragaje umubiri we ku mugaragaro nk'uko abigenza. Igihe cyose mbimubwiye atekereza ko namwita indaya.

Mfite imyaka ibiri mpura n'umusore, ndamukunda ariko sincyarizi, ndi mu kigero cy'imyaka 20, kandi nabana na we mu gihe kinini cy'imishyikirano yacu, nagiye njya kuganira n'inshuti y'umusore, kandi numva akunzwe cyane kurusha umukunzi wanjye.
Mfite indwara yo kwiheba, kandi mu mpeshyi y'umwaka ushize byari bibi cyane, ndarota kenshi, kandi nirinda ikintu cyose cyatuma numva nk'uko nagize muri iyo mpeshyi.

Ndi umunyeshuri w'umutoza w'amashuri yisumbuye. Ndi n'amezi atanu atwite. Ndetse naremerewe n'umukunzi wanjye w'imyaka itatu. Ababyeyi banjye ntibashaka ko tuvugana. Ntashobora no kuza gusura umuganga wanjye w'abagore. Mama ajya mu biro by'abaganga banjye bose. Anshyigikira. Ariko nifuza ko umukunzi wanjye yaba iruhande rwanjye kandi agashobora kubona umukobwa we kuri sonogram, nibura. Umuryango wanjye ntumva ko akwiriye ibyo byinshi. Ndarira igihe cyose kuko
Umugabo wanjye yakoresheje amagambo menshi mabi kugira ngo ankoze ku mutima, maze njya mu rugo.
Iyo abantu banyitayeho, numva ntishimye cyane, kuko bituma ntashaka kuvugira mu ruhame cyangwa gusubiza ibibazo mu ishuri.
Ubu nagiye mu mihango mishya y'ubuvuzi, ariko buri gihe iyo ninjiye numva mfite ubwoba kandi nkumva nihebye.
Mfite abavandimwe batatu. Mama arabakunda, ariko jye si ko ankunda. Buri gihe arantuka, ariko iyo bigeze ku bavandimwe banjye, abavugisha. Buri gihe ndarira mu cyumba cyanjye.

Umugabo wanjye yafashe akazi hanze y'igihugu mu mwaka ukurikiyeho kandi asa n'umuntu utandukanye. Mbere yaho yakoraga, akaryama, kandi ku minsi y'ikiruhuko, yagumaga mu rugo kuko nta kindi yakoraga. Ubu ajya gusohoka n'inshuti ze nijoro rimwe mu cyumweru, mu gihe nanjye nkiri mu rugo nkora akazi k'amasaha 50 mu cyumweru kandi nkita ku bana babiri jyenyine.
